SSH 密码、私钥与机器身份: SSH passwords, private keys and machine identity
主动安装 Agent 无需把 SSH 凭据交给控制端。选择 SSH 安装时，密码: Installing the Agent yourself does not require sharing SSH credentials with the control plane. When you choose SSH setup, the control plane processes the password, private key and key passphrase to connect to your designated machine.
任务凭据以 AES-256-GCM 加密保存，任务完成、失败、取消或过期后清除任: Task credentials are encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Their ciphertext is cleared when the task completes, fails, is canceled or expires; automatic expiry cleanup requires the task service to be running. You may explicitly choose long-term encrypted storage and later delete that stored copy in the console.
加密密钥由部署者保管，控制端执行 SSH 安装时需要解密凭据。这是静态存储加密，: The operator holds the encryption key. The control plane must decrypt credentials to perform SSH setup. This is encryption at rest, not end-to-end encryption that hides data from the server. Each Agent has a separate identity whose digest is stored in the database.
创建协议部署时，控制端处理你提供的 TLS 证书与私钥，并生成客户端认证凭据。敏: When you create a protocol deployment, the control plane processes your TLS certificate and private key and generates client authentication credentials. Sensitive configuration is encrypted with AES-256-GCM, bound to its organization, machine and deployment, and delivered to the authorized managed Agent to run the service.
部署列表不返回凭据。只有组织所有者或管理员主动查看连接信息时，才返回客户端认证凭: Deployment lists do not return credentials. Only an organization owner or administrator who explicitly views connection details receives client credentials and the public certificate; the action is audited. TLS private keys are never returned. Service configuration on the machine must still contain the keys needed to operate, stored with restricted permissions.
当前生成的协议运行时配置禁用流量日志。机器心跳、部署任务结果与审计事件仍会保存；: Generated protocol runtime configurations currently disable traffic logs. Machine heartbeats, deployment results and audit events are still stored. This does not replace checking the actual operating system, proxy or cloud-platform logging configuration.
Cookie、访问日志与第三方: Cookies, access logs and third parties
控制台使用必要的 xingdu_session Cookie 维持登录，会话有效: The console uses the necessary xingdu_session cookie to maintain sign-in for 24 hours, with HttpOnly and SameSite restrictions. The Secure attribute depends on deployment configuration; public deployments should use HTTPS. Signing out revokes the session and clears the cookie.
部署者配置 Resend 后，注册邮箱、验证码及邮件内容会发送给 Resend: If the operator configures Resend, the registration email address, verification code and message content are sent to Resend for delivery. Passwords, SSH credentials and node private keys are not included. Xingdu stores only a verification-code digest, not the plaintext code. Without a working email service, no email is sent and verification is not bypassed.
选择 Google 或 GitHub 登录、绑定时，浏览器会跳转至对应服务授权。: Choosing Google or GitHub sign-in or linking redirects your browser to that provider for authorization. The provider processes the visit and authorization request; Xingdu receives a user identifier and verified email for identity checks. Xingdu does not request access to repositories, contacts or cloud drives, and does not retain identity-verification access tokens as long-term credentials. A provider-verified email matching an existing Xingdu account’s verified email automatically links and signs into that account. Matching usernames alone do not link accounts. Previously linked identities continue to be identified by their stable provider identifier.
第三方授权流程使用短期安全状态与 Cookie 校验请求来源。解绑会移除星渡账号: Third-party authorization uses short-lived secure state and cookies to validate the request. Unlinking removes the association in Xingdu; it does not delete the provider account or necessarily revoke the provider’s app authorization. You can revoke authorization in the provider’s account settings. At least one Xingdu sign-in method must remain available.
云端计费启用后，支付页面与账单管理由 Stripe 提供。星渡保存组织对应的 S: When Cloud billing is enabled, Stripe hosts checkout and billing management. It does not store full card numbers or security codes; card information goes directly to Stripe. Machine addresses, SSH credentials and node keys are not sent to Stripe.

组织管理员可删除服务器资料、删除保存的 SSH 凭据、撤销邀请或机器接入，也可移: Organization administrators can delete server records and saved SSH credentials, revoke invitations or machine access, and remove members. Other members’ access depends on their organization role.

SSH 安装必须固定并校验主机指纹。用户应通过云控制台或已有可信连接独立核对指纹: SSH setup requires a pinned, verified host fingerprint. Independently check it through the cloud console or an existing trusted connection. An automatic scan alone does not prove machine identity.

Agent 使用 HTTPS 和独立机器凭据主动连接控制端。管理员可撤销身份，阻: Agents initiate HTTPS connections using independent machine credentials. Administrators can revoke an identity to block future heartbeats and incomplete enrollment. Revocation is not remote uninstallation.

Agent 接入与 SSH 安装怎么选？服务器管理的权限与凭据边界: Agent or SSH setup? Permissions and credential boundaries for server management
了解主动安装 Agent 与通过 SSH 安装的区别、探针模式和托管模式的权限，: Compare direct Agent installation with SSH setup, understand probe and managed-mode permissions, and learn why revoking machine access does not uninstall remote services.
SSH 是安装方式，Agent 是后续管理连接: SSH installs the Agent; the Agent handles ongoing management
Agent 接入与 SSH 安装并不是两套互斥的运行模式。在星渡中，可以在服务器: Agent enrollment and SSH setup are not mutually exclusive runtime modes. Install the Agent yourself or authorize the control plane to install it over SSH. After installation, the Agent connects using its own machine identity, reports heartbeats and handles tasks within its authorization.
主动安装适合已经有可信终端访问方式、希望自行执行安装步骤的用户，无需把 SSH: Direct installation suits users with trusted terminal access who want to run setup themselves, without sharing an SSH password or private key. SSH setup starts from the management interface but requires a target address, login method and independently verified host fingerprint.
为什么安装前需要核对 SSH 主机指纹: Why verify the SSH host fingerprint?
服务器地址用于找到连接目标，主机指纹用于确认目标身份。如果只接受一次扫描得到的指: The address locates the target; the host fingerprint verifies its identity. Accepting a scanned fingerprint without checking another trusted source skips that verification. At first enrollment or after reinstalling a server, get the fingerprint through the cloud console or an existing trusted connection and compare it with the requested value.
星渡对 SSH 连接目标有范围限制，默认拒绝回环、私有、链路本地和已知云元数据地: Xingdu restricts SSH targets, rejecting loopback, private, link-local and known cloud-metadata addresses by default. The operator must explicitly allow private management networks; members cannot relax the policy. This is control-plane deployment configuration, not a connection problem solved by changing a password.
探针与托管模式按任务选择: Choose probe or managed mode by task
探针模式以专用低权限用户运行，主要用于获取机器状态。托管模式需要明确授权更高权限: Probe mode runs as a dedicated low-privilege user and primarily collects machine status. Managed mode requires explicit authorization for elevated permissions to perform restricted installation, removal and management tasks. Understand that scope before deploying protocols; an online probe does not imply deployment permissions.
Agent 机器身份与浏览器登录身份独立。撤销用户会话和撤销机器身份解决的是不同: Agent machine identities are independent of browser sign-in identities. Revoking a user session and a machine identity address different problems. When someone leaves the team, separately review memberships, shared client credentials and machine access.
加密保存不代表服务端无法读取: Encrypted storage does not hide credentials from the server
通过 SSH 安装时，控制端需要使用凭据连接服务器。任务凭据加密保存，并在任务结: SSH setup requires the control plane to use credentials to connect. Task credentials are encrypted and cleared after completion or expiry; automatic expiry cleanup requires the task service. You may explicitly choose long-term storage and delete that copy later.
这些措施保护静态存储中的敏感信息，但不属于对服务端不可见的端到端加密。控制端执行: These measures protect sensitive data at rest; they are not end-to-end encryption that prevents server access. The control plane must decrypt credentials for installation. If you do not want it handling SSH credentials, install the Agent directly and retain server login credentials yourself.
停用前先安排远端服务的退出顺序: Plan the order for shutting down remote services
撤销机器身份会阻止后续接入，但不会停止已经部署的协议服务，也不会删除服务器软件。: Revoking machine identity blocks future access but does not stop deployed protocol services or remove server software. Uninstall the protocol and check the result before revoking access. Revocation cannot guarantee recall of operations already dispatched.
保留一个独立于星渡的服务器管理渠道，能够在 Agent 离线或控制端暂不可用时检: Keep a server-management channel independent of Xingdu to inspect the machine when its Agent or control plane is unavailable. Centralized management reduces repetitive work but still needs an explicit recovery path.
Stash、Mihomo、Surge、Loon 订阅怎么管理？格式、证书与链接更: Managing Stash, Mihomo, Surge and Loon subscriptions: formats, certificates and link updates
了解星渡客户端订阅如何组合节点和分流规则，各客户端格式有哪些协议与证书限制，以及: Learn how client subscriptions combine nodes and routing rules, the protocol and certificate restrictions of each format, and what editing, resetting or disabling a link actually does.
客户端订阅是一份可更新的配置: A client subscription is an updatable configuration
在星渡中，客户端订阅将当前组织选中的已部署节点与有序分流规则组合成配置。客户端每: A Xingdu client subscription combines selected deployed nodes in the current organization with ordered routing rules. The control plane regenerates it on each fetch. After changing nodes or rules, administrators need not redistribute the same subscription’s link, but clients must refresh it to receive changes.
这里的订阅不是付费套餐，也不是为每位使用者生成独立节点账号。当前基础订阅使用节点: This subscription is not a paid plan or a separate node account for each user. Basic subscriptions share existing node credentials. They do not provide per-user traffic tracking, independent quotas or immediate revocation of one person’s node access.
按实际客户端选择格式: Choose the format for the actual client
Stash 和 Mihomo 的字段映射分别实现，不能因为两个文件都是 YAML: Stash and Mihomo have separate field mappings; YAML files are not automatically interchangeable. Exports cover supported Trojan, VLESS, VMess, Hysteria 2 and TUIC v5 TLS nodes. Surge excludes VLESS. Loon excludes TUIC and uses system CA validation, requiring a valid domain and complete trusted certificate chain.
Hysteria 2 分享链接只适用于该协议，没有分流规则且默认流量走节点时才能: Hysteria 2 links apply only to that protocol and require no routing rules and node routing as the default. Shadowrocket has no dedicated output. Validate field support in the actual client version; disabling certificate checks is not a sound compatibility fix.
可以在单个订阅中配置精确域名、域名后缀或 IP CIDR 规则，按列表顺序匹配，: A subscription can match exact domains, domain suffixes or IP CIDRs in list order, choosing proxy, direct or reject behavior and a fallback for unmatched traffic. Domain rules use ASCII domains; convert internationalized names to Punycode. Suffix rules already include subdomains and need no wildcard.
配置前先写清楚意图：哪些目标必须经过节点，哪些允许直连，未命中规则时如何处理。当: Write down the intent first: which destinations must use a node, which may connect directly and what happens without a match. There is no shared rule library or route orchestration yet. Subscription rules are not server-side network access controls.
编辑、重置与停用有不同作用: Editing, resetting and disabling have different effects
编辑订阅改变后续生成的配置；重置链接使旧链接失效，并生成新的访问令牌；停用或删除: Editing changes future configurations. Resetting invalidates the old link and generates a new access token. Disabling or deleting stops future fetches. None of these recalls node credentials already downloaded or guarantees existing connections will close.
链接本身包含访问授权，持有者无需登录即可获取配置。不要放入公开截图、Issue: The link itself grants access: anyone holding it can fetch the configuration without signing in. Keep it out of public screenshots, issues and group announcements. After a leak, reset the link and assess whether node credentials were obtained. If necessary, remove and redeploy affected nodes to replace their credentials.
导出成功后，还要完成客户端验收: Successful export still needs client acceptance testing
当前适配器输出与部分配置解析已验证，所有目标 App 的实际导入及转发验收仍待完: Adapter output and some configuration parsing have been validated, but real import and forwarding tests across all target apps remain incomplete. Use a disposable test subscription without replacing everyday configs. Record the client name, version, operating system and results.
导入后检查协议、地址、端口、TLS 名称和证书校验设置。: After import, check protocol, address, port, TLS name and certificate-validation settings.
验证实际 TCP/UDP 转发，以及错误证书和错误认证会被拒绝。: Test real TCP/UDP forwarding and rejection of invalid certificates or authentication.
修改节点选择或规则后，主动更新订阅并确认变化。: After editing nodes or rules, refresh the subscription and confirm the changes.
确认旧链接失效与已下载凭据继续存在之间的区别。: Distinguish an invalidated old link from downloaded credentials that still exist.
完整客户端适配矩阵与验证记录: Full client-adapter matrix and validation records

需要了解机器状态的成员，不一定需要看到连接凭据或执行协议卸载。组织所有者和管理员: Someone who needs machine status may not need credentials or permission to uninstall protocols. 组织访问由应用权限与数据库行级隔离共同约束。隔离降低了跨组织误访问的风险，但无法: Application permissions and database row-level isolation jointly restrict organization access. 清点已分享的 SSH 凭据、客户端订阅链接和节点认证信息。: Inventory shared SSH credentials, client subscription links and node authentication details.

保留服务器独立管理方式与故障处理文档。: Keep independent server administration and incident-response documentation.

Xingdu Cloud 使用 Resend 投递注册与找回密码验证码、安全通知: Xingdu Cloud uses Resend for registration and password recovery codes, security notices, organization invitations and plan notifications. Resend receives the recipient address and message content, which may include an organization name, invitation link or plan status, but never passwords, SSH credentials or node private keys. Only hashes of verification codes are stored. The asynchronous notification queue stores recipient addresses, notification content and delivery status; the running delivery service removes records older than 30 days. This is not the retention period for all business data or provider copies. Self-hosted operators configure their own email service.
